name: swiftui-for-humans
description: Current SwiftUI for iOS and macOS 26–27, Apple's design guidelines as decision rules, App Store review rules, and a SwiftUI linter, as four skills.

interface.shortDescription: Current SwiftUI, Apple design rules, and App Store review rules
interface.longDescription: Four skills from the SwiftUI for Humans app: swiftui-build (current SwiftUI APIs, default code, and pitfalls for iOS and macOS 26–27), apple-design (the Human Interface Guidelines as decision rules), app-store-ship (App Review guideline numbers and App Store Connect forms), and swiftui-review (a checklist plus a linter for deprecated APIs and HIG smells).
defaultPrompt: Build a settings screen in SwiftUI for iOS 26
Review my SwiftUI views for deprecated APIs and HIG problems
Check this app against the App Review Guidelines before I submit
